packs.name: dbSNP - chromosome 22 common variant identities
packs.description: Reference variant identifiers, assembly-specific alleles, and merged identifiers.
packs.attribution: dbSNP, National Center for Biotechnology Information, U.S. National Library of Medicine. Converted to an indexed local reference format.
packs.coverage: Official chr22 RefSNP records for 33,721 of 33,892 explicit rsIDs in the fixed public gnomAD 4.1.1 PASS/AF>=0.001 chr22 corpus; all documented GRCh37/GRCh38 alleles and available active-record merges. The 171 missing IDs are reported. Not genome-wide.
